paragraphs: Rav Yirmeyah of Difti said in the name of R. Assi of Nehar Bol [the cited comparison in Ḥullin 87b gives R. Assi of Neharbil and Rav Yirmeyah as separate speakers]. R. Yirmeyah said to Rav Ashi, 'Thus said Rav Yirmeyah of Difti,' Zevaḥim, end of chapter 1 (15, beginning of side b). He spoke to Rav Kahana [an alternate attribution in the cited passage], Bava Batra (171b). R. Menashya, his son. He said: Rav Pappi acted in a case, Bava Batra (52a), Sanhedrin (27a). 'Rav Pappi told me personally,' Avodah Zarah (40a). Rav of Difti, his son—this requires examination. In Rava's name, Zevaḥim (34b). Rabbah Zuti said to Rav Ashi, 'Thus said R. Yirmeyah of Difti,' Menaḥot (31b). Ravina sat before him, Kiddushin (33a). Ravina ben Kisi (see his entry). Rami bar Ḥama said to him, Megillah (18b, 19a).
